text: {"452":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"`ResolverExpand` is defined by rustc_expand as the dependency-breaking expansion interface."},"453":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_ast"],"refers":["rustc_resolve"],"why":"It describes the dependency-inversion interface enabling AST code to access resolver services, rather than resolver behavior itself."},"454":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"ExtCtxt and ExpansionData are rustc_expand infrastructure for intermediate expansion state."},"455":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Annotatable and AstFragment are expansion-layer representations of macro-produced AST fragments and attribute targets."},"456":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"MacResult's polymorphic conversion into AstFragment kinds is expansion-layer behavior."}}
